_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} i Tic Tac Toe.
Ko tō whāinga ia ko te wikitoria i te toru i te rārangi (i ngā taha, i ngā poupou, i ngā tihi rānei) i runga i te papa.
I tō wā, me whiriwhiri koe i te numera poraka (0-8) e hiahia ana koe ki te whakapai i tō tohu ki reira.
He tauira, '[4]' e whakapai ana i tō tohu ki te poraka pokapū o te papa.
He Kaitakaro {player_id} koe, ka ko koe '{symbol}', ko tō hoariri '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore te nekehanga i tukuna e whai ana ki te hōputu tika.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ehara i te pūtau whaimana. Me noho ki waenganui 0 me 8.

game_action.placed: Kaitakaro {player_id} i whakapai i tōna tohu ({symbol}) ki roto i te poraka {cell}.
